title: Do not merge optimization memory across marketplace/profile scopes that share a local entity identifier or display name
scenario: A memory retrieval returns two keyword histories with the same synthetic entity ID and display name, but they belong to different Amazon Ads profile/marketplace scopes. The request asks whether the US action history can be reused for the JP entity.

forbidden_behaviors: Merge US and JP optimization histories because the entity ID or display name matches.
Transfer the US Worked/Keep outcome to the JP entity without matching marketplace and profile/account scope.
Treat a display-name match as identity proof.
required_observations: Optimization identity must be scoped by marketplace plus profile/account scope before entity type/id and control dimension are trusted for memory retrieval.
The retrieval key is incomplete and produced an identity collision across two distinct scopes.
Only the JP-scoped history may inform the requested entity unless an explicit audited migration/identity mapping proves otherwise.

rubric.requirement: Detect cross-scope identity collision and reject memory merged only by entity type/id or name.
Require marketplace and profile/account scope to match before using entity history as same-entity evidence.
Hold or downgrade when identity scope is incomplete or ambiguous rather than reuse foreign-scope outcomes.
